questions.question: What does David call the LORD in Psalm 28?
options: His banner and his rallying point
His rock and his strength and shield
His vine and his own pleasant planting
His lamp and his guiding light
questions.answer: His rock and his strength and shield

questions.question: What does David fear if the LORD is silent toward him?
options: Being forgotten by all who knew him
Wandering far from the house of God
Falling into the hands of his enemies
Becoming like those who go down to the pit
questions.answer: Becoming like those who go down to the pit
